verdict.rationale: Square documents a Locations API for retrieving and updating location information, and notes that more locations can be created beyond the default one. An official MCP server gives an agent a plausible path to call these APIs. The reader half of the story is unevidenced: the Terminal API appears only in a checkout/tipping context, with nothing showing readers can be registered or paired to a location via API. Missing for 10: explicit create-location API docs, API-based reader/device registration or pairing to a location, an end-to-end agent provisioning example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
